pt.headline: Ondas perfeitas e vento leve na Ribeira d'Ilhas!
pt.advice: Aproveite ondas de 2,1 m com período de 9 s e vento de 6 kt, ideal para manobras. Aviso à navegação costeira ANAV NR 1727/26 (Animais Marinhos - Avistamento) em vigor na zona – fique atento, mas nada impede de surfar. Chegue cedo para garantir seu pico.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 08:00 para evitar a maior parte da multidão.

en.headline: Perfect waves and light wind at Ribeira d'Ilhas!
en.advice: Take advantage of 2.1 m waves with a 9‑second period and 6 kt wind, perfect for maneuvers. Coastal navigation warning ANAV NR 1727/26 (Marine Animals – Sighting) is in effect – stay aware but it won’t stop you. Arrive early to claim your peak.
en.crowdTip: Get there before 08:00 to beat most of the crowd.

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas consistentes de 2 m e vento moderado (6 kt). Aviso costeiro ANAV NR 12/24 e NR 2257/26 em vigor.
spots.enReason: Consistent 2 m waves and moderate wind (6 kt). Coastal warnings ANAV NR 12/24 and NR 2257/26 active.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Vento mais forte (9 kt) pode atrapalhar a qualidade das ondas de 1,9 m.
spots.enReason: Higher wind (9 kt) may affect the quality of the 1.9 m waves.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas, mas vento quase nulo pode gerar swell irregular; atenção ao tráfego de barcos.
spots.enReason: Good waves, but almost no wind can cause irregular swell; watch for boat traffic.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Maior altura (2,1 m) e vento leve (6 kt). Aviso ANAV NR 1727/26 em vigor.
spots.enReason: Higher height (2.1 m) and light wind (6 kt). Coastal warning ANAV NR 1727/26 active.

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de 2,1 m e vento de 6 kt, excelente para tubos. Aviso ANAV NR 1727/26 em vigor.
spots.enReason: 2.1 m waves and 6 kt wind, excellent for barrels. Coastal warning ANAV NR 1727/26 active.

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Ondas menores (1,7 m) e vento muito leve (3 kt); pode ser menos excitante.
spots.enReason: Smaller waves (1.7 m) and very light wind (3 kt); may be less exciting.

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas curtas (1,5 m) e vento forte (8 kt) dificultam a surfabilidade. Avisos ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26 e 2235/26 em vigor.
spots.enReason: Short waves (1.5 m) and strong wind (8 kt) hinder surfability. Coastal warnings ANAV NR 00/14, 1445/26 and 2235/26 active.
